Grid.dist_strictMono.statement: (Stronger version of Lemma 2.1.2) Let $X$ be a pseudometric space carrying the standing data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q$, $K$, $\sigma_1$, $\sigma_2$, $F$, $G$ of `ProofData` (so in particular $X$ is a doubling measure space with a compatible family $\Theta(X)$ of functions), together with a grid structure `GridStructure` on $X$ with the default parameters $D=D(a)$, $\kappa(a)$, $S(X)$. If $I<J$ are grid cubes, then for all $f,g\in\Theta(X)$ $$d_{c(I),\,D^{s(I)}/4}(f,g)\le C_{2.1.2}(a)\,d_{c(J),\,D^{s(J)}/4}(f,g),$$ where $d_{x,r}$ denotes the distance between functions on the ball $B(x,r)$.
